title: DPC 0.9.178-dev1 (the Lua split into parts): does everything still work like 0.9.177?
intro: About 8 minutes. Nothing should feel different from 0.9.177. Start as the Arisen, full party, co-op off, out of combat on open ground. You'll need a second controller for step 4. If anything errors or acts oddly, note the step.

probes.ver: local A=_G.DPC_API; return A and A.dpc_version or 'no API'
probes.played: local A=_G.DPC_API; local s=A and A.state(); return s and s.played and (s.played.name or '?') or '-'
probes.arisen_ai: local A=_G.DPC_API; local s=A and A.state(); return s and tostring(s.arisen.ai_on) or '-'
probes.coop: local A=_G.DPC_API; local s=A and A.state(); if not (s and s.coop.active) then return 'off' end; local n=0; for _ in pairs(s.coop.players) do n=n+1 end; return n..' players'

steps.text: SPLIT CHECK. The top line should read 0.9.178-dev1. Arisen, co-op off, out of combat. Press End.
1/7 Take control of a melee pawn (F6, or L1 + left stick click). Press End when you're playing them.

2/7 Three goblins that can't die appear. Fight about 30 s: attacks, a skill, guard or dodge. Watch the Arisen: he should fight on his own (arisen_ai = true). Press End to spawn them, End again is the next step.
3/7 Switch to another pawn (same button), then hold D-pad down to go back to the Arisen. Press End.
4/7 Co-op: press Ctrl+F6, then touch the second controller (it becomes player 2). Split screen and the player cards should come up as before. Fight the goblins a little with both players. Press End.
5/7 Player 2 holds L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to leave. Player 1 stays on his character. Press End.
6/7 Open the REFramework menu (Insert), DPC settings: change one main choice you'll remember (e.g. camera turning), close the menu. Press End.

7/7 Last: after this step, in the REFramework menu press Reset Scripts. Then check: the DPC window shows 0.9.178-dev1, the setting you changed in step 6 is still changed, no error at the top of the menu, and F6 takes a pawn once (not twice). Tell Claude how each step went. Press End to finish.
